products.name: Eightfold AI
products.note: Talent intelligence platform; skills matching; DEI bias risk; high-stakes employment decisions

profile_text.body:
Eightfold is a talent intelligence company whose platform is aimed at HR leaders and recruiting teams. The company describes itself as "the agentic talent intelligence company" and positions its software as covering hiring, talent management, and workforce deployment. Its core claim is that AI supports recruiters rather than replaces their judgment, with the company stating explicitly that its AI "never decides" and that recruiters retain final authority over hiring outcomes.

The main product is the Eightfold AI platform, which the site describes as spanning recruiting, candidate screening, skills matching, and talent management. A specific feature called Eightfold AI Interviewer conducts candidate interviews and produces summaries for recruiters. The company cites customer outcomes including a 33% reduction in time-to-fill for some users and roles filled in as little as 1.3 days in high-volume hourly hiring contexts. Eightfold also describes holding a certification against what it calls "the world's first AI management standard," with independent auditors testing the platform for bias and results made available publicly.

The site's held facts classify the Eightfold AI platform under HR and Talent AI, noting its application to skills matching, DEI bias risk, and high-stakes employment decisions. No litigation, SEC filings, patent records, or MCP server registrations are present in the available data.
